ui.title:
Find
Your
Program
ui.lede: Stamp the square that sounds like you. Fill your card, shout bingo, meet your stream.
ui.fine: {n} questions, about two minutes. Anonymous: we never ask your name.
ui.scaleAsk: How much is this like you?
ui.cardHint: Each stream owns one line through the star. Fill it and shout bingo.
ui.idle: Back to the welcome screen in {s} seconds for the next visitor.

steps.apply: Applications open after Al Sharq Forum 2026. Leave your details on the 2027 interest form. Network members get special places.
steps.under18: Join your local hub now. {stream} is one to apply to when you turn 18.
steps.over35: Contribute to a hub as a professional: mentor, speak or train. Pass {stream} on to a friend.
steps.lowTime: Start at your local hub. {stream} asks 5 to 10 hours a week, so keep it for when you have more time.

late-night.q: Late at night, my mind usually goes to…

answers.a: Big questions about why the world is the way it is
answers.b: A debate from today and what I’d say next
answers.c: An idea I want to start building
answers.d: Plans for the next meet-up with people in my city

friends.q: Friends usually come to me when they need…

answers.b: Help turning a messy idea into a plan
answers.c: Someone to get people together for an event
answers.d: Someone who knows the right people around town

conference.q: At a conference like this one, I am most likely…

answers.a: Taking notes in the front row
answers.b: Talking with a speaker in the corridor
answers.d: Swapping numbers with people from my city

funding.q: If my community had funding, I would start by…

answers.b: Testing a small solution next week
answers.c: Designing a project with clear goals
answers.d: Bringing the neighbours together to decide

group-work.q: In group work, I am usually the one who…

answers.a: Asks why we are doing this
answers.b: Turns the idea into a step-by-step plan
answers.c: Makes sure everyone feels part of the team

city-problem.q: When something in my city isn’t working, I…

answers.d: Find out who is responsible and talk to them

saturday.q: A Saturday I would call well spent…

answers.a: A book club or a good debate
answers.b: A build day on a project with a team
answers.d: A meet-up with my local community group

topic.q: The topic I would read about first…

answers.e: Life and projects in my city

leader.q: For me, a good leader mostly…

this-year.q: What would make you feel this year was worth it?

answers.c: I found my people in my city
answers.d: I understood a big issue deeply

statements.why-first: I like digging into why things are the way they are.
statements.conversations: I enjoy talking with people whose views differ from mine.
statements.direction: When my team or friends can’t agree, I help us find common ground.
statements.sketch-fix: When I see a problem, I start thinking about how to solve it.
statements.idea-project: I have an idea I want to launch as my own initiative.
statements.show-up: I can get people to join a charity drive.
statements.decisions: I want a say in how things are run in my community.
statements.local-group: I want a local group I meet, talk and run things with.
statements.build-learn: I like testing an idea quickly to see if it works.
statements.public-life: I’d like to start an awareness campaign with my community.

time.q: Honestly, how many hours a week could you give?

big.name: The Big-Picture Thinker
big.line: You always ask why, and connect the dots.

dial.name: The Conversation Starter
dial.line: You think best by talking it through.

lead.name: The Steady Leader
lead.line: People look to you, and you listen first.

design.name: The Problem Solver
design.line: You see a problem and sketch a fix.

launch.name: The Starter
launch.line: You’d rather build it than talk about it.

mobil.name: The Rallier
mobil.line: When it matters, you get people moving.

civic.name: The Change Seeker
civic.line: You want to know who decides, and why.

hub.name: The Bridge Builder
hub.line: You turn where you live into a community.
